items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: telling the drummer to start filling. Herb Barman and Bull Ruther. What a wild rhythm section that was.

ctx.x: There’s one cymbal crash that everybody thinks is cymbal, and it’s me going “schewwwww,” telling the drummer to start filling. Herb Barman and Bull Ruther. What a wild rhythm section that was. So I always think, boy . . . Then we took that group to New York, didn’t we? To Birdland.
What would have been their first – would that have been the first time you performed in New York?
